$comment: Preview gate policy. Read by deploy/hermes/saucerjam-community-triage.md and docs/AUTOMATION.md. Change numbers here, not in prose.

gate.rationale: Distinct voters, not total votes: one person must not be able to stack a request. Maps to 'enough different people want this'.

tiers.label: early
tiers.note: Seed stage. 3 distinct voters is a 'worth about a day of my time' bar, not a demand signal.

tiers.label: growth
tiers.note: 10% of the active voter pool, floor 5. The floor stops drive-bys from being the whole signal.

tiers.label: scaled
tiers.note: 15% of the active voter pool, floor 10. Revisit quarterly.

bypass._comment: Categories that do not need votes at all.

effort_override._comment: Below the vote bar, still allowed if the spike fits the budget. Larger than this goes on the roadmap instead of getting a preview.

reach._comment: Who gets told about a preview. Keep it to the people who asked: 100 players of all skills mostly want a finished feature, not a beta. 3-5 real testers is a better instrument than a broadcast.

player_panel._comment: Method for judgment calls that are not vote-gated. See references/player-panel-method.md.
use_for: should this be built at all
positioning or pricing or first-impression risk
